theme: 3 terms on class inheritance: reuse, replace and lock

terms.definition: A feature that lets a class get the properties and methods of another class.
terms.example: Use inheritance, so `GroupChat` gets everything from `Chat`.

terms.definition: A keyword that lets a subclass replace a method it got from its parent class.
terms.example: Write the override keyword, so `Taxi` can replace `honk`.

terms.definition: A keyword that stops a class or method from being inherited or overridden.
terms.example: Mark `Token` as final, so nobody can subclass it.

video.title: Inheritance, Override & Final | iOS Daily English Day 16
video.description:
Learn to talk about Swift class inheritance: Inheritance, Override and Final, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Inheritance - A feature that lets a class get the properties and methods of another class.
Override - A keyword that lets a subclass replace a method it got from its parent class.
Final - A keyword that stops a class or method from being inherited or overridden.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 16 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: Swift Inheritance, Override & Final in English | Chat | Day 16
landscape.description:
Explain Inheritance, Override and Final in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
상속, 오버라이드, final 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Inheritance - A feature that lets a class get the properties and methods of another class.
한국어: 타입 간 상속: 다른 클래스의 프로퍼티와 메서드를 물려받는 기능

Override - A keyword that lets a subclass replace a method it got from its parent class.
한국어: 부모 클래스에서 받은 메서드를 서브클래스가 바꿔 쓰게 하는 키워드

Final - A keyword that stops a class or method from being inherited or overridden.
한국어: 클래스나 메서드가 상속 또는 재정의되지 못하게 막는 키워드

In this video, Mina and Jake build a `GroupChat` from a `Chat` class and learn what each word does, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

퀴즈 정답을 댓글로 남겨주세요 (1/2/3). 모든 댓글에 답글 달아요. 한국어 댓글도 환영!

dialogue.title: The GroupChat class

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I want a `GroupChat` that works like `Chat`, with a new title.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So with inheritance, I get all the `Chat` code for free?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. Now `title` must return "Group" for this chat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, that breaks every chat. Override it in `GroupChat` instead.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Oh, so override replaces the method only for the subclass?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Got it. Maybe someone will inherit from `GroupChat` later.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Don't allow that. Mark it final, so nobody can subclass it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nice. Final tells the whole team this class ends here.
Use inheritance, so `GroupChat` gets everything from `Chat`.
